recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. The current source is correct for FHIR-19241, and any future mustSupport wording work should be handled under newer targeted issues rather than by reapplying this STU3 link-only request.
issue_request: FHIR-19241 was a Published FHIR-core change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking the conformance-rules Must Support text to help readers reach the section explaining what kind of support mustSupport requires. The accepted resolution was to normalize the name from Must-Support to mustSupport, link the relevant occurrences, and not link the literal words "kind of support" directly.
initial_application: Upstream commit 3cece068c4c9b9eeb6d5ee32372b98ad7be1a747 ("GF#19241 - must-support -> mustSupport") applied the issue by changing conformance-rules.html terminology and linking the StructureDefinitions text to profiling.html#mustsupport. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key: FHIR-19241 commit existed on the combined branch.
additional_context: Later conformance work introduced the Implementation Obligations page and moved the detailed kind-of-support explanation there, while profiling.html retained Must Support / Implementation Obligations anchors. Later FHIR-38134 and FHIR-50391 clarified mustSupport inheritance and repeating/sliced-element behavior; both are already represented on the combined branch and do not require another decision here.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. source/conformance-rules.html now uses mustSupport, mentions the ElementDefinition property in profiles, and points to source/obligations.html; source/obligations.html states that profiles SHALL define exactly what kind of support is required. This satisfies the approved FHIR-19241 clarification without adding redundant cross-links.
